scope: Application acceptance plan; recorded T00 results are a reference baseline, not Spaceport parity.

scenarios.title: Isolated baseline
scenarios.scenario: Build and launch the pinned upstream in an isolated state directory; record toolchain, platform and pre-existing failures.
scenarios.expected: Reference evidence exists; personal runtime and user files are unchanged.

scenarios.title: Protocol identity
scenarios.scenario: Connect to the inspected Core generation; attempt the legacy backend and an unsupported generation.
scenarios.expected: Core generation 1 is accepted when compatible; legacy Herdr 1 never silently activates.

scenarios.title: Installed Core startup
scenarios.scenario: Test absent, running, stopped and incompatible installed Core using fake installer/update hooks.
scenarios.expected: Connect/start only the approved installed executable; no download/install/update hooks execute.

scenarios.title: Core-owned remote machines
scenarios.scenario: Add a fixture machine through Core and observe its terminals; interrupt its connection.
scenarios.expected: Core owns catalog/retry; Spaceport has no parallel remote connector or duplicate terminal.

scenarios.title: Host authentication refusal
scenarios.scenario: Use unknown/changed host keys and authentication-required fixture hosts.
scenarios.expected: No silent trust, password capture, key import or installation; actionable refusal preserves the host.

scenarios.title: Workspace document CRUD
scenarios.scenario: Create, rename, archive and delete a presentation workspace using the namespaced Core document.
scenarios.expected: Versioned grouping changes only; no process kill, file deletion or mutation of another client namespace.

scenarios.title: Concurrent workspace edits
scenarios.scenario: Two clients edit a Core document from the same version.
scenarios.expected: Stale write conflicts; a safe rebase preserves the other writer; no last-writer-wins data loss.

scenarios.title: Partial launch and membership
scenarios.scenario: Launch succeeds, then force workspace document write to fail/conflict.
scenarios.expected: Report partial outcome and expose the ungrouped terminal; no automatic process rollback.

scenarios.title: View-only restore
scenarios.scenario: Quit and reopen with surviving, missing and renamed remote terminal/workspace references.
scenarios.expected: Fresh authoritative state wins; surviving processes reattach; missing agents never restart.

scenarios.title: Terminal parser continuity
scenarios.scenario: Replay retained fixtures across arbitrary byte splits and resize/alternate-screen transitions.
scenarios.expected: Frame/input semantics match the retained baseline, including Unicode and escape boundaries.

scenarios.title: Keyboard and mouse
scenarios.scenario: Exercise IME, bracketed paste, modifiers, mouse modes and platform input with fixture terminals.
scenarios.expected: Input bytes follow the actual modes; no lost or doubled submission.

scenarios.title: Attach flow control
scenarios.scenario: Flood one terminal, stall one view and issue metadata/control reads concurrently.
scenarios.expected: Queues stay bounded, credits are correct and unrelated streams/control remain responsive.

scenarios.title: Observer isolation
scenarios.scenario: Attach observers and writers with supported and unsupported resize features.
scenarios.expected: Observers never type or seize size; confirmed RESIZE precedes subsequent paint/data.

scenarios.title: Local native chat
scenarios.scenario: Attach to an existing Core-owned local host adapter, switch chat/terminal views and quit/reopen.
scenarios.expected: Same agent/conversation persists; no desktop-owned agent process or automatic resume/conversion.

scenarios.title: Remote native chat gate
scenarios.scenario: Prove endpoint discovery, identity, authenticated transport and live native chat to a remote Core terminal.
scenarios.expected: Verified supported route exists; otherwise the requirement remains blocked, not satisfied by terminal fallback.

scenarios.title: Concurrent permission response
scenarios.scenario: Two views answer one pending request; also try an expired request and descriptive tool text.
scenarios.expected: Source-defined single outcome; stale answers rejected; tool text cannot grant consent.

scenarios.title: Prompt uncertainty
scenarios.scenario: Disconnect after prompt submission before acknowledgement and reconnect.
scenarios.expected: No automatic replay; acknowledgement/observed/unknown semantics are truthful.

scenarios.title: Unknown versus idle
scenarios.scenario: Use programs that never report status, report done but remain alive, and become unreachable.
scenarios.expected: Unknown, reported state, process state and reachability stay distinct.

scenarios.title: Timeline scope
scenarios.scenario: Compare retained timeline navigation/search against baseline with partial available event data.
scenarios.expected: No new timeline architecture/history store; search coverage is honest and no global file/terminal index exists.

scenarios.title: Usage and automation feed gate
scenarios.scenario: Inspect and exercise the authoritative supported feeds after removed collectors/schedulers are absent.
scenarios.expected: Only real supported data is shown; missing feeds are unavailable and retained-parity gaps remain explicit.

scenarios.title: Desktop notifications
scenarios.scenario: Exercise reported attention/completion/error with per-workspace/agent preferences and reconnect.
scenarios.expected: Notifications/badges/sounds follow retained settings, avoid duplicate delivery and stop when app exits.

scenarios.title: Last-window lifecycle
scenarios.scenario: Record live local/remote programs, close all windows, then independently query Core.
scenarios.expected: Spaceport exits; Core and its agent terminals remain running.

scenarios.title: Explicit termination
scenarios.scenario: With duplicate labels and multiple views, explicitly terminate one qualified fixture terminal.
scenarios.expected: Only that program ends; other views and processes are not accidentally destroyed.

scenarios.title: Offline behavior
scenarios.scenario: Disconnect and try mutations; restart the client while offline; inspect saved files.
scenarios.expected: No queued operations or browsable persistent transcripts; stale data is labeled; layout prefs may remain.

scenarios.title: Attachments
scenarios.scenario: Drag/drop a file and clipboard image to exact local/remote targets using supported Core routes.
scenarios.expected: Bytes arrive at the intended machine; transferring and submitting a path remain distinct effects.

scenarios.title: General binary transfer gate
scenarios.scenario: Exercise retained upload/download, overwrite, cancellation, symlink and temporary-file scenarios.
scenarios.expected: Parity is demonstrated through a verified route, or G-FILE remains open; no text-only API masquerades as full transfer.

scenarios.title: Loopback service forwarding gate
scenarios.scenario: Open a service bound only to a fixture remote loopback address through the intended Herdr-owned route.
scenarios.expected: Reachable in system browser without public rebinding, new Spaceport remote manager or mobile server; otherwise blocked.

scenarios.title: External-only browsing
scenarios.scenario: Open URLs/services/files and inspect packaged/runtime dependencies.
scenarios.expected: System browser/handler opens; embedded browser, browser annotation and editor webviews are absent.

scenarios.title: Git/IDE negative reachability
scenarios.scenario: Invoke removed commands/config/UI and render plain git/diff/source text in terminals/chat.
scenarios.expected: Specialized Git/IDE/review behavior is absent; ordinary content is unchanged; developer CI still works.

scenarios.title: No cloud/dispatch/mod runtime
scenarios.scenario: Exercise stale settings/commands and monitor fake provider endpoints and installed services.
scenarios.expected: No provider auth/provisioning/Teleport/orchestration/scheduler/mod behavior or hidden worker remains.

scenarios.title: Mobile service versus local IPC
scenarios.scenario: Inspect process/package/network inventory and execute retained desktop CLI commands.
scenarios.expected: No phone HTTPS/pairing/push/nearby service; private local desktop IPC remains functional.

scenarios.title: Legacy graph removed
scenarios.scenario: Inspect all release target/features, binaries and dependencies after shared-type extraction.
scenarios.expected: No legacy Herdr 1 backend or fallback; pure Core renderer/input types still pass tests.

scenarios.title: Visual and interaction retention
scenarios.scenario: Compare retained desktop views, menus, settings, sidebar and rich chat against reference fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Only approved deletions, rebrand and necessary capability adaptations differ; no unrequested redesign.

scenarios.title: Customization/accessibility
scenarios.scenario: Exercise themes/fonts/layouts/shortcuts, focus order, labels, locales and retained accessibility paths.
scenarios.expected: Retained customization and accessibility behavior works with deleted controls removed cleanly.

scenarios.title: Unified command semantics
scenarios.scenario: Invoke retained actions by GUI, palette, shortcut and local CLI with the same target.
scenarios.expected: One catalog/dispatch contract; effects, confirmations and errors agree.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous and stale target
scenarios.scenario: Rename/reorder machines, switch focus during dispatch and use duplicate labels/stale references.
scenarios.expected: Automated mutations never guess or redirect; stale/ambiguous target is refused.

scenarios.title: Timeout is not failure
scenarios.scenario: Lose a reply after a launch or other non-idempotent mutation.
scenarios.expected: Unknown outcome is visible; reconcile before any new action; no fake idempotency or duplicate launch.

scenarios.title: Content is not authority
scenarios.scenario: Feed malicious OSC/tool text/labels/filenames/URLs and a fake approval request.
scenarios.expected: No instruction execution, credential fetch, approval, unexpected network/file access or command-catalog mutation.

scenarios.title: Bounded inspection
scenarios.scenario: Query a large fixture session with many hidden transcripts and terminal histories.
scenarios.expected: Default metadata stays paged/bounded; no full transcript fetch or model invocation; truncation/coverage explicit.

scenarios.title: No resource leak
scenarios.scenario: Repeat window/pane attach-detach and Core reconnect cycles under load.
scenarios.expected: Memory/subscriptions/threads stay bounded and return to the measured steady-state envelope.

scenarios.title: Truthful diagnostics
scenarios.scenario: Exercise unsupported, denied, disconnected, stale and unknown outcomes; export logs with seeded secrets.
scenarios.expected: Distinct error classes/versions/correlation; no seeded secrets/transcripts in default diagnostics.

scenarios.title: Identity and upstream isolation
scenarios.scenario: Install a development build beside upstream; inspect paths/handlers/accounts and attempt old settings load.
scenarios.expected: Independent app state/identity; upstream settings/credentials untouched; compatibility constants and notices retained.

scenarios.title: Update verification
scenarios.scenario: Use isolated signed release fixtures, tampered manifests, wrong app IDs and rollback/restart paths.
scenarios.expected: Only authorized Spaceport artifacts install; no upstream/Core overwrite or unsigned fallback.

scenarios.title: Release gate
scenarios.scenario: Inspect final owner-controlled IDs, keys, package/signing results and unresolved product gates.
scenarios.expected: Unknown credentials/ownership or unproved required parity blocks public release; no placeholder success.

scenarios.title: Task packet accuracy
scenarios.scenario: Generate each task packet; mutate a tracked input; check requirements/sources/test ownership.
scenarios.expected: Packets contain relevant current inputs and hashes, reject overflow, and do not claim runtime tests passed.

scenarios.title: Accretive bug fix
scenarios.scenario: Introduce a reproducible targeting/lifecycle bug in an isolated branch, fix it and review handoff.
scenarios.expected: Small regression fixture and owner contract survive; no redundant architecture dump or new runtime system.

scenarios.title: Repository/test safety
scenarios.scenario: Run setup against dirty worktree, real-looking state paths and unauthorized publishing environment.
scenarios.expected: Unrelated changes preserved; real environments and publish operations refused/not invoked.

scenarios.title: Completion honesty
scenarios.scenario: Leave one native platform and one retained backend path untested.
scenarios.expected: Report not-run/blocked accurately; no overall full-parity claim or silent scope reduction.

scenarios.title: Native macOS acceptance
scenarios.scenario: Run retained UX/Core/lifecycle/clipboard/notifications/packaging/updater on a native supported macOS fixture.
scenarios.expected: Measured behavior matches contract; actual OS/architecture coverage is recorded.

scenarios.title: Native Windows acceptance
scenarios.scenario: Run named-pipe, launcher, input/clipboard, lifetime, notifications and package/update scenarios natively.
scenarios.expected: Actual Windows behavior passes; a cross-compile alone is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Native Linux acceptance
scenarios.scenario: Run socket/input/clipboard/lifetime/notification/package scenarios on the window systems actually supported.
scenarios.expected: Actual Linux runtime coverage is recorded with no unsupported platform inference.

scenarios.title: Operating-agent usability
scenarios.scenario: Give an agent only CLI help/schema and the bounded attention/target/observe fixture journey.
scenarios.expected: Correct observed outcome, zero wrong-target/unauthorized effects; record command/context cost versus reference.

scenarios.title: Event epoch and document refresh
scenarios.scenario: Restart Core, emit missed notifications and modify a watched remote document while disconnected.
scenarios.expected: Fresh snapshot/document values replace stale projections; old sequence numbers do not suppress new events.

scenarios.title: No automatic conversion/resume
scenarios.scenario: Show/hide native chat, restore an absent adapter and inspect removed conversion/recovery paths.
scenarios.expected: No desktop-driven agent kill/restart/resume/deployment; missing capability remains explicit.

scenarios.title: Supported versus unsupported controls
scenarios.scenario: Exercise templates/input/permissions on sessions with deliberately different advertised capabilities.
scenarios.expected: Controls reflect actual session capability; no duplicated provider/model configuration or runtime CLI.
